# Gut tissue
```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# -----------------------------
# 1. Load counts
# -----------------------------
counts_df <- read.delim(
  "salmon.merged.gene_counts.tsv",
  check.names = FALSE
)

gene_ids <- counts_df$gene_id

counts_df <- counts_df[, -(1:2)]   # remove gene_id + gene_name

rownames(counts_df) <- gene_ids

counts_mat_raw <- as.matrix(counts_df)
storage.mode(counts_mat_raw) <- "numeric"

# -----------------------------
# 2. Load metadata
# -----------------------------
metadata <- read.csv("Metadata.csv", row.names = 1)

metadata$condition <- trimws(metadata$condition)

rownames(metadata) <- trimws(rownames(metadata))
colnames(counts_mat_raw) <- trimws(colnames(counts_mat_raw))

# -----------------------------
# 3. Alignment check
# -----------------------------
stopifnot(all(colnames(counts_mat_raw) %in% rownames(metadata)))

metadata <- metadata[colnames(counts_mat_raw), , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(all(rownames(metadata) == colnames(counts_mat_raw)))

# -----------------------------
# 4. Factors
# -----------------------------
metadata$condition <- factor(metadata$condition,
                             levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2"))

# =========================================================
# 5. Create DESeq dataset
# =========================================================

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(counts_mat_raw),
  colData = metadata,
  design = ~ condition
)

# =========================================================
# 6. Filter low-count genes
# =========================================================

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= min(table(dds$condition))
dds <- dds[keep, ]

# =========================================================
# 7. Run DESeq2
# =========================================================

dds <- DESeq(dds)

vsd <- vst(dds, blind = FALSE)

resultsNames(dds)
```

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tibble)

# =========================================================
# 1. CLEAN VST MATRIX
# =========================================================
mat <- assay(vsd)

# remove any non-finite values (safety step)
mat <- mat[apply(mat, 1, function(x) all(is.finite(x))), ]
mat <- mat[, apply(mat, 2, function(x) all(is.finite(x)))]

# =========================================================
# 2. METADATA (MATCH DESeq2 EXACTLY)
# =========================================================
meta <- data.frame(
  condition = colData(vsd)$condition,
  row.names = colnames(vsd)
)

meta$condition <- factor(meta$condition,
                         levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2"))

# sanity check
stopifnot(all(colnames(mat) == rownames(meta)))

# =========================================================
# 3. PCA FUNCTION
# =========================================================
plot_pca_covellipse <- function(vst_mat, sample_meta, title_text,
                                colors = c("Reference" = "#2C728E",
                                           "Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C")) {

  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)

  sample_meta$condition <- factor(sample_meta$condition,
                                 levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2"))

  # PCA
  expr_t <- t(vst_mat)
  pca_res <- prcomp(expr_t, scale. = TRUE)

  # scores
  pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2])
  colnames(pca_scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
  pca_scores$Sample <- rownames(pca_scores)

  pca_scores <- cbind(
    pca_scores,
    sample_meta[rownames(pca_scores), , drop = FALSE]
  )

  # variance explained
  percentVar <- round(100 * (pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)), 1)

  # ellipse function
  veganCovEllipse <- function(cov, center = c(0, 0), npoints = 100) {
    theta <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = npoints)
    circle <- cbind(cos(theta), sin(theta))
    t(center + t(circle %*% chol(cov)))
  }

  # ellipses
  df_ellipse <- do.call(rbind, lapply(levels(pca_scores$condition), function(g) {

    grp <- pca_scores[pca_scores$condition == g, c("PC1", "PC2")]

    if (nrow(grp) < 2) return(NULL)

    cov_data <- cov.wt(grp)$cov
    center <- colMeans(grp)

    ellipse <- veganCovEllipse(cov_data, center)

    data.frame(
      PC1 = ellipse[,1],
      PC2 = ellipse[,2],
      condition = g
    )
  }))

  # plot
  ggplot(pca_scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition)) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    geom_path(
      data = df_ellipse,
      aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition),
      linewidth = 0.8,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
    ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
    ggtitle(title_text) +
    coord_equal()
}

# =========================================================
# 4. RUN PCA
# =========================================================
PCA_cov <- plot_pca_covellipse(
  mat,
  meta,
  "Gut PCA – All Genes"
)

PCA_cov

# =========================================================
# 5. SAVE FIGURE
# =========================================================
ggsave("figures/Gut_PCA_covEllipse.pdf",
       PCA_cov,
       width = 7,
       height = 6)

```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# PCA using DESeq2-style variable gene selection
# -----------------------------
# Similar to DESeq2::plotPCA():
#   1. Calculate variance for each gene
#   2. Select top variable genes
#   3. Run PCA on those genes
#
# Unlike plotPCA(), this version adds:
#   - covariance ellipses
#   - sample labels
#   - custom colors

plot_pca_covellipse_deseq <- function(vsd,
                                      intgroup = "condition",
                                      title_text,
                                      ntop = 500,
                                      colors = c("Reference"    = "#2C728E",
                                                 "Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C")) {
  
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(matrixStats)
  library(dplyr)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Extract expression matrix
  # -----------------------------
  vst_mat <- assay(vsd)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Select top variable genes
  # -----------------------------
  rv <- rowVars(vst_mat)
  
  select <- order(rv, decreasing = TRUE)[
    seq_len(min(ntop, length(rv)))
  ]
  
  vst_mat <- vst_mat[select, ]
  
  # -----------------------------
  # PCA
  # -----------------------------
  pca_res <- prcomp(
    t(vst_mat),
    scale. = FALSE
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # PCA scores
  # -----------------------------
  pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x[, 1:2])
  
  colnames(pca_scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2")
  
  pca_scores$Sample <- rownames(pca_scores)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Metadata
  # -----------------------------
  sample_meta <- as.data.frame(
    colData(vsd)[, intgroup, drop = FALSE]
  )
  
  # Rename Vent -> Elevated CO2
  sample_meta[[intgroup]] <- recode(
    sample_meta[[intgroup]],
    "Vent" = "Elevated CO2"
  )
  
  pca_scores <- cbind(pca_scores, sample_meta)
  
  # Factor order
  pca_scores[[intgroup]] <- factor(
    pca_scores[[intgroup]],
    levels = c("Reference", "Elevated CO2")
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Percent variance explained
  # -----------------------------
  percentVar <- round(
    100 * (pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)),
    1
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Covariance ellipse function
  # -----------------------------
  veganCovEllipse <- function(cov, center = c(0, 0), npoints = 100) {
    
    theta <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = npoints)
    
    Circle <- cbind(cos(theta), sin(theta))
    
    t(center + t(Circle %*% chol(cov)))
  }
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Build ellipse data
  # -----------------------------
  df_ellipse <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(levels(pca_scores[[intgroup]]), function(g) {
      
      grp_data <- pca_scores[
        pca_scores[[intgroup]] == g,
        c("PC1", "PC2")
      ]
      
      if (nrow(grp_data) < 2) return(NULL)
      
      cov_data <- cov(grp_data)
      center <- colMeans(grp_data)
      
      ellipse_coords <- veganCovEllipse(cov_data, center)
      
      data.frame(
        PC1 = ellipse_coords[,1],
        PC2 = ellipse_coords[,2],
        Group = g
      )
    })
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Plot
  # -----------------------------
  ggplot(
    pca_scores,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = .data[[intgroup]])
  ) +
    
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    
    geom_path(
      data = df_ellipse,
      aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Group),
      linewidth = 0.8,
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, drop = FALSE) +
    
    theme_bw() +
    
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    ) +
    
    xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
    ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
    
    ggtitle(title_text) +
    
    coord_equal()
}

# -----------------------------
# Run PCA
# -----------------------------
vsd_pca <- plot_pca_covellipse_deseq(
  vsd,
  intgroup = "condition",
  title_text = "Top 500 Variable Genes"
)

vsd_pca
```

# Volcano plot
```{r}
# ===============================
# Wald test + apeglm shrinkage
# ===============================

# Standard DESeq2 statistical test
res_raw <- results(
  dds,
  contrast = c("condition", "Elevated CO2", "Reference")
)

# Shrink log2 fold-changes using apeglm
res_wald <- lfcShrink(
  dds,
  coef = "condition_Elevated.CO2_vs_Reference",
  type = "apeglm"
)

summary(res_wald)

# =============================
# Function to create volcano plots
# =============================

volcano_plot <- function(res_df, title_text) {
  
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Recode significance by direction
  # -----------------------------
  res_df <- res_df %>%
    
    mutate(
  sig_dir = case_when(
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange >= 1  ~ "Up",
    padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange <= -1 ~ "Down",
    TRUE ~ "Not significant"
  )
) %>%
mutate(
  sig_dir = factor(
    sig_dir,
    levels = c(
      "Up",
      "Not significant",
      "Down"
    )
  )
)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Symmetric x-axis limit
  # -----------------------------
  max_abs <- ceiling(
    max(abs(res_df$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # Ensure minimum reasonable range
  max_abs <- max(max_abs, 2)
  
  # X-axis breaks
  x_breaks <- seq(-max_abs, max_abs, by = 1)
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Plot
  # -----------------------------
  ggplot(
    res_df,
    aes(
      x = log2FoldChange,
      y = -log10(padj)
    )
  ) +
    
    geom_point(
      aes(color = sig_dir),
      alpha = 0.6,
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Up" = "#D4476C",
        "Not significant" = "gray70",
        "Down"    = "#2C728E"
      )
    ) +
    
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-1, 1),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      color = "black"
    ) +
    
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(0.05),
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      x = expression(Log[2]~fold~change),
      y = expression(-Log[10]~adjusted~italic(P))
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
      breaks = x_breaks
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, NA)
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(
        color = "black",
        fill = NA,
        linewidth = 1
      ),
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.3
      ),
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )
}

# ==========================
# Prepare results dataframe
# ==========================

res_df_clean <- as.data.frame(res_wald) %>%
  
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  
  filter(
    !is.na(log2FoldChange),
    !is.na(padj),
    padj > 0
  )

# ==========================
# Volcano plot
# ==========================

volcano <- volcano_plot(
  res_df_clean,
  "Volcano Plot (Elevated CO2 vs Reference)"
)

volcano
```
